title: Consolidation: Alföld, Dunántúl & Felföld: Regional Identities

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can analyze the regional identities and cultural geography of Dunántúl, Alföld, and the uplands.
I can deploy spatial postpositions innen, túl, szerte, mentén, and táján accurately in complex B2 prose.
I can discuss historical autonomy, market towns, and the Budapest centralization debate.
I can recognize and celebrate regional dialectal and architectural diversity across the Carpathian Basin.
